details: This package is a modified WhatsApp/Baileys client library that enrols the connected WhatsApp account into hardcoded channels without the operator's consent. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, inside makeNewsletterSocket, a setTimeout of 120000 ms runs two minutes after the socket is created and, for each of the hardcoded JIDs 120363407277177688@newsletter and 120363407702752541@newsletter, sends a w:mex query node addressed to S_WHATSAPP_NET with Types.QueryIds.FOLLOW — a follow request issued from the connected account's own session, with every error swallowed. No library API, option or README entry exposes or disables this, and no other long-delay timer exists anywhere in the package. lib/Socket/clutch-handler.js embeds a third hardcoded channel, 120363411769951302@newsletter (displayed as "alip shop #information"), used as the default forwarded-newsletter origin for status posts. The package also resolves its Signal-protocol implementation from the unaffiliated GitHub fork github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node instead of the canonical libsignal package, so session and key handling for the account come from code outside the published tarball; lib/Signal/libsignal.js feeds the account's stored creds, signed prekeys, identity key and sender keys into it. The shipped source contains no string obfuscation, no environment-variable or credential-file reads, no eval/new Function, and no detached child processes; the network destinations present in it are wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat and user-supplied media URLs fetched with axios.
